svg.text: NEMOS_SimulationAnalysis.py — turn a solved case into images, numbers and spreadsheets
Separate from the run pipeline: it only reads the case folder from disk, through PyVista's OpenFOAM reader. Run it from its own script.
cells + fields T, U, p, k …
when created: set_time(t), then create them.
Slice at value on 'xy', 'xz' or 'yz' (default: mid-plane);
vector fields are drawn as magnitude.
One point, or mean/min/max/std over a 'sphere', 'plane' or 'box'.
The same history as a plot; blocks until the window closes.
probe_to_excel() exists but currently fails — see examples/07_analysis_full.py
n1 × n2 regular grid on one plane; T and U sampled,
Image of that plane. plot_2D(plane, …) opens it instead.
The same over the whole room (50³ = 125 000 points).
Image of the grid. plot_reg_3D(grid, …) opens it instead.
CFD cells are irregular; spreadsheets want a grid.
